chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Miskan, from Abi Basir, who said:

I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who doubted and did not know whether he had performed one sajdah or two sajdahs. He said: He should perform sajdah until he becomes certain that they are two sajdahs.
ai.seo_question: What should someone do in salat if he doubts whether he performed one sajdah or two?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding doubt in the number of sajdahs performed in salat. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that the person should continue until he is certain that two sajdahs have been completed.
